dedupe_keys.name: total and rural 2g to 4g mobile coverage as a proxy of the digitalisation of agriculture by country and world region 2015 2022 cirad

description: Series of rural, urban and total population coverage by 2G to 4G mobile networks, with rural, urban and total population, for many countries and for continents and groups of countries by income and geography, from 2015 to 2022. The CIRAD Dataverse record says the files also give the data sources and the detailed results of equations fitted to the data, which describe an inequality relation between total and rural coverage and predict rural coverage from total coverage, as a proxy for the digitalisation of agriculture. Version 1 was released on 22 April 2025 by Jean-Marc Roda, Matthieu Bufkens and Philippe Cadene, with a linked paper marked as submitted. It holds four small downloadable files (three RData files and a text list of sources, about 17 KB in total), free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is worldwide by country and region. Caveats: the data are national aggregates in R format, and the underlying coverage figures come from third-party sources listed in the files. For simulation it gives the rural telecom coverage gap by country, to test how far digital farm services, early warning and market information can reach. A related catalogue record is the Collins Bartholomew Mobile Coverage Explorer.
